comparison_scope: Each row holds the financial circuit, flag, proved prior, probability tolerance and per-price confidence fixed. Only the amplitude estimator is changed. Optimised flag searches are not plotted.
phase_register_interpretation: Width of the QPE phase register, not the exact increment in peak qubits; reported old and new peaks are conservative upper bounds.
plotting_precision: Integers and exact rational ratios establish all resource quantities. Float logarithms determine drawing coordinates only.
